rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for a household kettle used to boil water.

example.english: The kettle is still boiling water, so don't touch it.
example.traditional: 個水煲仲煲緊水，唔好掂住。
example.jyutping: go3 seoi2 bou1 zung6 bou1 gan2 seoi2 m4 hou2 dim6 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when presenting the kettle as a general water vessel rather than specifically as a household boiling appliance.

example.english: The kettle on the table is for pouring water.
example.traditional: 枱面嗰個水壺係用嚟斟水嘅。
example.jyutping: toi2 min6 go2 go3 seoi2 wu4 hai6 jung6 lai4 zam1 seoi2 ge3
